test_title: PYST 74: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct Active Voice form of the given sentence:

The flight announcement was being made by the staff when I entered.

options.text: The staff made the flight announcement when I entered.
The flight announcement made the staff when I entered.
The staff was making the flight announcement when I entered.
The staff has made the flight announcement when I entered.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice: "The flight announcement was being made by the staff when I entered." 
 
• To convert a passive voice sentence into active voice, the subject and object switch their roles. 
 
• In the passive sentence, the subject is "The flight announcement," and the agent performing the action is "the staff." 
 
• The verb phrase "was being made" is converted to "was making" to reflect the continuous action in the active voice. 
 
• The time clause "when I entered" remains unchanged. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**. 
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The staff was making the flight announcement when I entered."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: **"The staff made the flight announcement when I entered." – Incorrect as it changes the tense from past continuous to simple past. 
 
• **Option 2: **"The flight announcement made the staff when I entered." – Incorrect as it changes the subject-object relationship incorrectly. 
 
• **Option 4: **"The staff has made the flight announcement when I entered." – Incorrect as it changes the tense to present perfect, which is inconsistent with the original sentence. 

5f:T
